text:
Anya (Product): Quick sync request — customer 'Beacon' asks for an official latency SLA for chat: p95 <= 120ms on their prompt set. They want launch in ~6 weeks. Need cross-team alignment on whats realistic and the fallback policy.

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Short answer: doable with dedicated resources + KV prewarm + tight batching knobs, but current p95 on that model is ~135ms under realistic pilot traffic. I can try micro-optimizations but need infra changes.

Jasper (Infra): Infra can provision a dedicated reserved pool and set prewarm hooks. Question: do we pin GPUs or use autoscale with min_instances? For SLA we recommend pinning 3 nodes for the pilot. Cost delta estimate coming.

Maria (Eng-Platform): Ill make a route-level toggle and console flag for the pilot: prefetch=true, min_instances=3, force_quant=bf16. Will open a tiny PR with the UI toggle and API flag. Example flag payload well use for tests: {"route": "/beacon-chat", "prefetch": true, "min_instances": 3, "quant": "bf16"}

Kevin (Security): Security requirements: dedicated KMS key for all pilot material, explicit retention policy doc for logs, and redaction checks on any inference traces. Ill draft a checklist for compliance signoff.

Lucy (PM): Beacon confirmed they can cover reserved pool costs for the pilot. They need an acceptance checklist with measurable gates. Can we draft acceptance criteria now?

Anya (Product): Acceptance gates I want now: 1) p95 <= 120ms on Beacon prompt set over 10k samples; 2) error-rate delta <= 0.1% vs baseline; 3) dedicated KMS + retention doc signed off; 4) rollback plan and automatic fallback route to a lower-cost variant if SLA violated.

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Ill own perf test harness, runload + synthetic + Beacon prompts, and iterate kernel selection and batching. ETA: prototype perf run in 3w if infra prioritized.

Jasper (Infra): Ill scope reserved pool provisioning and prewarm script, and post cost estimate today. Decision: new reserved nodes for isolation (will be slightly slower to provision but safer).

Maria (Eng-Platform): Ill ship the route flag PR and a console toggle. Also add a feature flag to enable automatic fallback to 'latency-optimized' model variant.

Kevin (Security): Drafting KMS + retention doc now. Also will run a quick scan for PII leakage in our eval traces before signoff.

Lucy (PM): Ill coordinate Beacons prompt set and acceptance window. Also happy to drive weekly status with customer.

Anya (Product): Great. Action items due by EOD Friday: Sam post perf test plan; Jasper cost + infra timeline; Maria PR link; Kevin compliance checklist; Lucy confirm prompt set timeframe. Ill compile a pilot playbook afterward.

deploy-bot: Calendar: Pilot kickoff check-in scheduled Monday 10:30am PT. Invite sent.

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Note: if we need sub-120ms steady-state we might need to tweak batching targets per route. Ill include a recommended batching config in the plan.

Jasper (Infra): FYI Ill need 48-72h to provision and smoke test dedicated nodes once approved.

Maria (Eng-Platform): PR created: https://git.internal/r/platform/pulls/4321 (will update with tests).

Kevin (Security): Uploaded initial KMS/retention draft here: https://docs.internal/security/beacon-kms-draft.md

Lucy (PM): Beacon will send the prompt set by Wednesday EOD.

Anya (Product): Thanks all, Ill assemble the playbook and publish in this thread. Follow-up sync Monday.
